name: freeup-space
description: Review cleanup opportunities on macOS and Windows with Quick Scan, Deep Scan, or Deep Scan + AI.

interface.shortDescription: Scan, select items and confirm cleanup in a widget.
interface.longDescription: Choose Quick Scan, Deep Scan or Deep Scan + AI in an interactive widget. Watch live progress, expand categories, select individual items, preview your selection and confirm recoverable moves to Trash or Recycle Bin.
interface.defaultPrompt: Open Freeup Space so I can choose a scan, review categories and select items to move to Trash.
